items.name: Rhodonite tower
items.alt: Tall pink rhodonite tower with black veins
items.desc: Rose pink with black veins running through it like ink dropped in water. The big one. Put it on a shelf and everything next to it looks better.

items.name: Flower agate tower
items.kind: One of a kind · 5 in tall
items.alt: Pale pink and white flower agate tower with small crystal pockets
items.desc: Blush pink and cream, freckled with white blossoms and a few crystal-lined pockets that catch the light. Like a cherry tree that decided to become a rock.

items.name: Ruby in zoisite tower
items.alt: Green and black ruby in zoisite towers with raspberry pink patches
items.desc: Moss green and black with pops of raspberry red. No two are patterned alike, so we pick the one that seems most ready to leave.

items.name: Septarian tower
items.desc: Honey-yellow calcite cracked through with chocolate-brown lines. It formed in mud on an ancient seabed, which is about as dark a backstory as a rock gets.

items.name: Quartz flame
items.alt: Large polished clear quartz flame with a faint pink glow
items.desc: A big polished flame of quartz, mostly clear with soft clouds and rainbows inside when the sun hits it. Looks like frozen candlelight.

items.name: Rainbow moonstone flame
items.alt: White rainbow moonstone flame with black tourmaline patches
items.desc: Milky white with black tourmaline streaks at the tip and base, and a blue flash that shows up when you tilt it toward a window.

items.name: Flower agate sphere
items.alt: Three flower agate spheres on small stands
items.desc: Round, glossy, and patterned in blush, cream and crystal. Stand included, because a sphere without one is just a marble with ambitions.

items.name: Grape agate cluster
items.alt: Lavender grape agate cluster with tiny round crystal bubbles
items.desc: Lavender bubbles of crystal piled up like a bunch of grapes, with little white starbursts underneath. Nobody believes it's natural. It is.

items.name: Lapis lazuli heart
items.alt: Deep blue lapis lazuli heart with gold pyrite flecks
items.desc: Midnight blue with gold flecks of pyrite scattered across it like a night sky somebody spilled glitter on.

items.name: Carnelian heart
items.desc: Glossy orange-red with darker swirls inside, like looking into a cup of tea held up to a lamp.

items.name: Golden sheen obsidian palm stone
items.alt: Black golden sheen obsidian palm stone with a gold shimmer
items.desc: Looks plain black until the light moves, then a gold sheen slides across it. Volcanic glass, polished smooth enough to keep in a pocket.

items.name: Amethyst palm stone
items.alt: Six polished amethyst palm stones in lavender and white
items.desc: Lavender to deep violet with white chevron bands. Every one is a slightly different shade of purple, which is the whole charm.

items.name: Green fluorite palm stone
items.alt: Three translucent green fluorite palm stones
items.desc: Translucent sea-glass green with little wisps and clouds inside. Hold one up to a window and it glows.

items.name: Septarian palm stone
items.alt: Five polished septarian palm stones in yellow, gray and brown
items.desc: Pocket-sized, polished, and striped like something out of a fossil drawer. Fits in your palm, as advertised.

items.name: Amazonite palm stone
items.desc: Sea-glass blue-green streaked with white, like sunlight on the bottom of a pool. Smooth enough that you'll keep picking it up.

items.name: Peach moonstone tumble
items.alt: A pile of tumbled peach and cream moonstones
items.desc: Soft peach and cream with the shimmer moonstone gets when it catches the light. The moon's stone. Obviously we had to.

items.name: Black tourmaline tumble
items.alt: Three glossy black tourmaline tumbled stones
items.desc: Deep glossy black with a few silver flecks. The little black dress of the rock world: goes with everything.
